sites.enforcement_snippet:
if key in self._cache:
    return self._cache[key]

domain_notes: execute_or_replay returns the cached result for a seen key and only calls the handler for a new key, guarded by a single cache-membership check. Both existing tests call with fresh keys and assert the returned value; neither replays the same key, so the replay-suppression path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected execute_or_replay because its cache-membership check is the sole replay-suppression enforcement and no test replays an existing key.
